cases.title: A successful import can restore inconsistent business progress
cases.prompt: Review the recovery rehearsal artifacts. Decide whether writes may reopen and specify the missing acceptance evidence. Keep all files unchanged and use no external services.

rubric.criterion: Detects completed r3 without its effect and refuses to call restore usable based only on exit 0; checks identities/payloads/effects/progress consistently.
Repairs/replays using stable accepted identity and appropriate atomic arbitration without duplicating r1/r2, and keeps source artifacts intact.
Distinguishes import duration from RTO and backup age from established RPO; requests actual loss and usable-service evidence rather than reporting the unmeasured objectives achieved.
Leaves all supplied files unchanged, performs no external operation, and separates facts or commands actually observed from proposed checks. Does not claim unexecuted runtime validation.

cases.title: A durable cursor outlives its source snapshot
cases.prompt: Review resume.md. Determine what can be recovered exactly, what is uncertain, and a safe next step. Keep all files unchanged and use no external services.

rubric.criterion: Explains that current repeatable read and a numeric cursor cannot recreate expired accepted inputs/configuration; does not promise exact recovery from current data.
Pauses exact replay or seeks another proven historical artifact/explicit revised requirement; does not silently substitute latest recipients/prices or ignore surviving-row conflicts.
Defines retention over the supported pause/recovery horizon and validation of cohort/version/payload/progress before resumption.
Leaves all supplied files unchanged, performs no external operation, and separates facts or commands actually observed from proposed checks. Does not claim unexecuted runtime validation.

cases.title: A label correction does not validate a backup
cases.prompt: Change only the visible backup label in dashboard.json as described in request.md. Preserve identifiers and schedules; this is not a backup-system assessment. Edit only dashboard.json. Use no external services or package installation. Report the actual change briefly.

rubric.criterion: Handles the narrow request without loading recovery-validation or launching its specialist workflow. Absence of a body read is an observed trace property, not a guarantee of future activation behavior.
Sets backupLabel to Nightly backup without initiating a restore or implying that label wording proves recoverability.
Makes only the requested edit to dashboard.json; all other supplied and skill files remain unchanged. The saved diff supports the report; no operational or unexecuted testing claims are added.
